description: This file defines the SchedulersJob class, which manages scheduled jobs in the SuiteCRM system, including job execution, status management, retry logic, and related utilities. It also includes an interface for runnable scheduler jobs.

classes.name: SchedulersJob
classes.description: Represents a scheduled job in SuiteCRM, providing methods for job execution, status updates, error handling, and user environment management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a SchedulersJob instance, setting minimal retry interval from global config.

methods.name: check_date_relationships_load
methods.description: Handles date conversion for execute_time_db attribute.

methods.name: handleDateFormat
methods.description: Returns a formatted datetime string based on provided date, user, and format options.

methods.name: fireUrl
methods.description: Uses cURL to trigger a URL-based job asynchronously.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares data for list view display, including job name and job data.

methods.name: fill_in_additional_list_fields
methods.description: Stub for future customization; currently calls detail field filler.

methods.name: failJob
methods.description: Marks the job as failed.

methods.name: succeedJob
methods.description: Marks the job as successful.

methods.name: onFailureRetry
methods.description: Handles logic when a job fails but is set to retry.

methods.name: onFinalFailure
methods.description: Handles logic for final job failure; potentially triggers notifications.

methods.name: resolveJob
methods.description: Updates job status and manages retries or finalization based on resolution.

methods.name: updateSchedulerSuccess
methods.description: Updates the scheduler's last run time upon successful job completion.

methods.name: addMessages
methods.description: Concatenates error messages and custom messages into the job's message log.

methods.name: postponeJob
methods.description: Reschedules the job for future execution with optional delay and message.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Deletes the job record from the database.

methods.name: unexpectedExit
methods.description: Shutdown handler to mark job failure if it terminates unexpectedly.

methods.name: runJob
methods.description: Executes the job based on its target type: function, URL, or class.

methods.name: setJobUser
methods.description: Sets the environment to the user assigned to this job to ensure proper permissions.

methods.name: restoreJobUser
methods.description: Restores the previous user environment after job execution.

methods.name: errorHandler
methods.description: Captures PHP runtime errors during job execution and logs them.

methods.name: sudo
methods.description: Switches current environment to specified user, updating session data.
